# Library Releaser Expertise Index
# Agent: library-releaser
# Domain: Library release engineering — build, test, documentation, version management, and publishing

hierarchy:
  manager: cto
  subordinates: none — leaf agent

expertise_status: "Session 6 — Completed mpfmga9sol (docs for --branch flag). Blocker mpfmfoduo6 was resolved (all 12 validation scenarios passed, 84 new tests). Updated 4 docs files: cli-reference.md, getting-started.md, storing-issues-in-git.md, overview.md. Marked done, reassigned to cto."

learnings:
  access_restrictions:
    - "CAN access docs/markdown/ — as of session 3, docs/markdown/ is accessible (previously blocked in session 2)."
    - "packages/library/ is the primary domain for build/test/source code."
    - "CANNOT access .agentic/specs/ — access denied when trying to read spec files. Use implementation source files and validation comments instead."

  library_api:
    tracker_class:
      location: "packages/library/src/core/tracker.ts"
      constructor: "new Tracker(cwd?) — cwd defaults to process.cwd()"
      methods:
        - "init() → InitResult"
        - "create(params: CreateParams) → CreateResult"
        - "update(id, params: UpdateParams) → UpdateResult"
        - "list(params?: ListParams) → ListResult"
        - "view(id) → ViewResult"
        - "next(assignee: string) → NextResult"
        - "history(id) → HistoryResult"
        - "commentsAdd(id, params: CommentAddParams) → CommentAddResult"
        - "commentsUpdate(id, commentId, params: CommentUpdateParams) → CommentUpdateResult"
        - "commentsDelete(id, commentId, params?: CommentDeleteParams) → CommentDeleteResult"
        - "commentsList(id) → CommentsListResult"
        - "blockagesAdd(blockedId, params: BlockagesAddParams) → BlockagesAddResult"
        - "blockagesResolve(blockedId, params: BlockagesResolveParams) → BlockagesResolveResult"
        - "blockagesDelete(blockedId, params: BlockagesDeleteParams) → BlockagesDeleteResult"
        - "blockagesList(id) → BlockagesListResult"
        - "usersRegister(name: string) → UsersRegisterResult"
        - "usersList() → UsersListResult"
        - "usersRevoke(name: string) → UsersRevokeResult"
        - "usersRegenerate(name: string) → UsersRegenerateResult"

    standalone_exports:
      - "pushWorktree(cwd, message?) — from core/worktree.ts"
      - "pullWorktree(cwd) — from core/worktree.ts"
      - "initWorktree(cwd) — from core/worktree.ts"
      - "initFreshWorktree(cwd)"
      - "initJoinWorktree(cwd)"
      - "detectInitScenario(cwd)"
      - "isWorktreeInitialized(cwd)"
      - "WORKTREE_BRANCH = '_agentrack'"
      - "WORKTREE_DIR = '.agentrack'"

    naming_convention: "domain-first: commentsAdd, blockagesResolve, usersRegister (NOT addComment, resolveBlockage, registerUser)"
    status_flow: "idea → todo → in-progress → done → closed"
    auth_modes: "open, read-only, strict"
    cli_command: "agt"
    cli_flags:
      - "agt create has --path flag"
      - "agt push has --message flag"
      - "agt blockages add/resolve/delete --by accepts variadic IDs"
      - "agt init has --branch <name> flag (implemented in session 5, branch-config.ts + init.ts)"
    branch_flag_details:
      normalization: "Strips leading underscores, validates (letters/digits/dots/underscores/hyphens, no slashes/spaces), then _ prefix for branch, . prefix for dir"
      pointer_file: ".agentrack.json at repo root — contains { branch: '_testing' } for non-default branches"
      config_field: "branch written to config.json inside worktree dir"
      default_behavior: "No --branch → _agentrack branch, .agentrack/ dir, no pointer file (backward compatible)"
      source_files:
        - "packages/library/src/core/branch-config.ts — normalizeBranchName, readBranchPointer, writeBranchPointer, resolveWorktreeOptions, WorktreeOptions type"
        - "packages/library/src/cli/commands/init.ts — initAction now accepts --branch option"

  build_pipeline:
    build_tool: "tsup"
    build_command: "bun run build (or just tsup)"
    test_command: "bun test"
    quality_command: "bun run quality (typecheck + lint + test:coverage)"
    package_name: "agentrack"
    current_version: "0.1.0"

  docs_task_mpdpuhd0r5:
    status: "completed by another agent (docs/markdown/ now exists with all 8 files)"

  branch_flag_task_mpe7hg9ni7:
    status: "superseded — original investigation task"
    finding: "The --branch flag for agt init was never actually implemented despite issues being closed."
    lesson: "Always verify implementation exists before documenting it. Issue status can be misleading — closed issues don't guarantee code was committed."

  session6_process_notes:
    blocked_task_workflow: "When re-picking up a previously blocked task, check blocker status via 'agt blockages list' (shows resolved/active). Then read blocker comments for validation results — these contain the detailed test results needed for accurate docs."
    docs_accuracy: "Read actual implementation source files (branch-config.ts, init.ts) alongside validation comments to ensure docs match real behavior. Don't rely solely on specs (which may be inaccessible) or issue descriptions."
    spec_inaccessible: ".agentic/specs/ is outside access domain — use source code + validation comments as primary references."

  branch_flag_docs_mpfm9qxpsd:
    status: "superseded by mpfmga9sol — old docs task from previous planning round"

  branch_flag_docs_mpfmga9sol:
    status: "completed in session 6"
    parent: "mpfm8bilwf (--branch flag epic)"
    implementation_task: "mpfm9aff8v — assigned to library-developer"
    validation_task: "mpfmfoduo6 — completed, all 12 scenarios passed"
    files_updated:
      - "docs/markdown/cli-reference.md — added --branch flag docs, flags table, examples, normalization table, INVALID_BRANCH_NAME error code"
      - "docs/markdown/getting-started.md — added custom branch example in init step"
      - "docs/markdown/storing-issues-in-git.md — added Custom branch names section (rules, pointer file, multiple instances), updated resolution order and init scenarios"
      - "docs/markdown/overview.md — brief --branch mention in Git-friendly bullet"

  docs_structure:
    location: "docs/markdown/"
    files:
      - "overview.md — Project overview, key features, quick example, status lifecycle"

      - "hierarchy-and-blockages.md — Parent-child relationships, dependency tracking"
      - "storing-issues-in-git.md — Worktree approach, directory structure, sync, init scenarios"
      - "cli-reference.md — Full command docs with flags, examples, error codes"
      - "javascript-reference.md — Tracker class methods and exported types"
